text:
elaine: Heads-up — compliance flagged missing user attribution on several role change events from the private deploys API yesterday. katy mentioned it broke an automated quarterly report.

josh: got an example? which rows / service?

elaine: query we ran: 
```
SELECT actor_id, action, target, timestamp
FROM rbac_audit
WHERE timestamp >= '2026-03-18' AND action = 'role.update'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Most recent ones show actor_id = 'svc-rbac-proxy' for actions that appear to be initiated by human users (based on surrounding request_ids).

frank: that svc-rbac-proxy is the token-exchange proxy we added during the RBAC refactor to support KMS-wrapped deploy tokens. It SHOULD be setting act_as in the audit record.

elaine: right — the new refactor writes audit.actor = token.owner_id only if the request contains X-Act-As header. We see the header in the nginx access logs, but audit rows are still svc-rbac-proxy. snippet: 
```
nginx: 2026-03-18T21:02:11Z "POST /private/v1/roles/update" req_id=abcd1234 user="katy@example.com" x-act-as="katy" svc=svc-rbac-proxy
rbac-service: 2026-03-18T21:02:11Z role.update req_id=abcd1234 actor=svc-rbac-proxy
```

josh: hmm. so either the middleware that injects act_as to the audit context is skipping for private deploys route, or the audit writer ignores act_as if the actor is a registered service account.

frank: I grep'd the change-branch — middleware condition is: `if (auth.principal.type === 'user') ctx.audit.actor = auth.principal.id; else if (auth.principal.type === 'service') ctx.audit.actor = auth.principal.id;` — looks dumb but the exchange layer sets principal.type='service' for act-as flows. We intended to annotate `principal.actAs` and let audit writer prefer that, but a regression in 0f3b2b8 removed the prefer-actAs logic.

katy: compliance is asking for a remediation plan and an ETA for backfilling the last 48 hours. They need assurance this won't reoccur.

elaine: proposed actions: 1) create hotfix to restore prefer-actAs logic in audit-writer (patch PR ready but not merged) 2) run a backfill job to rewrite actor_id for affected req_ids using nginx logs 3) add an alert when >1% of role.update events have actor starting with "svc-" and have a matching x-act-as header in access logs 4) add e2e test that proxies with KMS tokens preserve act-as in audit.

josh: ack. I can fast-track review of the patch and deploy to staging. frank can you own the backfill query? we should do a dry-run.

frank: I’ll run a dry-run against replica: steps: 1) join rbac_audit rows to access_logs on req_id 2) where rbac_audit.actor = 'svc-rbac-proxy' and access_logs.x-act-as IS NOT NULL set new_actor=access_logs.x-act-as 3) write to audit_backfill table with original_row_id and new_actor. will run on Monday 03:30 UTC.

elaine: patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/compare/fix/audit-actas-0f3b2b8 — includes unit + integration test. pinged @josh for review.

audit-bot: Alert created: RBAC-AUDIT-01 — Detected 126 role.update events with service actor and matching x-act-as headers in logs (window 2026-03-18 20:00 - 2026-03-19 02:00). Severity: high.

katy: thanks. for compliance report we need a CSV of corrected events and proof the fix is deployed. Can frank include a mapping file with original_event_id, corrected_actor, evidence_log_line?

frank: yes — backfill job will emit a CSV to s3://redwood-compliance/backfills/2026-03-19/service-actas-correction.csv with those columns. will include md5 and job-run manifest.

josh: timeline: review + merge PR today, deploy to prod canary tonight (22:00 UTC), monitor for new svc-actor anomalies for 6 hours, then run backfill once PR is live. frank — keep dry-run results here and tag @katy when CSV is uploaded.

elaine: also we should add a short postmortem note: root cause = audit-writer regression from RBAC refactor removed prefer-actAs logic; contributing factor = lack of e2e test for KMS-wrapped tokens.

katy: perfect. Compliance will tentatively mark the incident as 'remediated pending backfill proof'.

frank: dry-run results: matched 134 candidate rows, 8 ambiguous (multiple access log matches) — will exclude ambiguous from automatic rewrite and hand-review.

josh: thanks. created Jira: INFSEC-4321 'Backfill svc act-as audit events' and assigned to frank. ETA: 48h.

elaine: final note — if anyone sees any role.update events appearing in reports with actor like svc-*, please screenshot and drop here.

katy: will update compliance ticket. :white_check_mark:
